h: Gunmen reportedly kill seven at a relaxation spot in Gyero, Jos South
p: Seven people were reportedly killed when gunmen attacked a relaxation spot in Gyero, in Jos South local government area of Plateau State. Details of the attack and the identity of the attackers have not been confirmed.
more: The latest attack comes as troops arrest a suspected militia member in nearby Mangu.
Security agencies have not yet issued a full statement on the incident.
